purpose: User-approved chief wild-hair redesign and exact sprite generation prompts

portrait.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. EDIT ONLY THE HAIR of the original orc chieftain in image1. User wants a WILD UNTAMED SAVAGE hairstyle, not a neat soldier haircut or groomed human hairstyle. Replace the short spiky undercut with coarse thick charcoal-black hair streaked with iron-gray, irregular rough shoulder-length locks falling over the back of neck and around the temples. Untamed wind-tossed mane with natural asymmetry, a few rough locks loosely caught behind the head with ONE worn plain leather cord, other locks falling free. Hairline uneven and rugged, no clean fade, no neatly shaved sides, no salon styling, no elegant ponytail, no ornate braids or beads, no dreadlocks, no horns, no feathers or skull ornaments. Keep hair away from most of the face so the amber eyes, scar and tusks remain clearly visible. It should feel like a battle-hardened wilderness chieftain who cuts his own hair with a blade and ties it for battle, fierce and feral rather than fashionable. ABSOLUTELY PRESERVE his exact face, age, expression, scars, tusks, ears, gray chin stubble, green skin, muscular exposed chest and arm, athletic narrow-waist body, posture, broken asymmetrical patchwork armor, repaired teal cloak, axe, background, framing, lighting and premium painterly quality. Do not alter his body or add more armor. Do not change any symbols or add insignia, text or logos. Only the head hair silhouette, length, rough texture and gray strands change, naturally integrating with existing light.
